Name: Japhia, King of Lachish
Summary: Japhia was king of Lachish and one of the five kings who allied against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua.
KeyStory: Japhia joined Adoni-zedek against Gibeon, fled to the cave at Makkedah, and was hanged with the other four kings.
LifeLesson: Alliances against God end in the same cave.
